ptm.evidence: Spectral searches were performed using a custom FASTA-formatted database that included common contaminants, reversed sequences (Uniprot Human, 2021) and the following parameters: 50 PPM precursor tolerance, fully tryptic peptides, fragment ion tolerance of 0.02 Da and a static modification by TMTPro16 (+304.2071 Da) on lysine and peptide N-termini.
